## Outcome

Describe the concrete change and its purpose.

## Tracking and decisions

Task IDs/issues, milestone, affected components and decision records. Distinguish proposed choices from accepted ones.

## Validation

Commands/scenarios and results; unavailable checks and why. For docs run `python3 scripts/check_docs.py`; for implemented components run their documented checks.

## Compatibility and release impact

Describe contract/schema/data migrations, offline behaviour, legal/store disclosure changes and rollout/recovery needs when applicable. Link release evidence for publication changes.
